name: Click Correction
description: Adds a pause menu button to forgive early clicks, with a configurable frame window.

enabled.name: Enable Click Correction
enabled.description: When enabled, a click made slightly <cy>too early</c> (while still in the air) is remembered and applied the moment you land. This can also be toggled from the pause menu.

max-frames.name: Max Correction Frames
max-frames.description: The maximum number of physics frames (steps) a click may be early and still be corrected. At 240 TPS, <cy>4</c> frames is roughly 17 ms.

show-pause-button.name: Show Pause Menu Button
show-pause-button.description: Show the Click Correction button in the pause menu.
